product.audience: Fashion-aware shoppers and stylists choosing a limited seasonal look
product.decision: See how each complete look moves, understand its layers and fit, then select a wearable size
product.conversion: Resolve one complete look and hold it in a chosen size with a numbered claim tag

signature.moment: A dark photographic contact sheet runs beneath the viewport while one selected campaign frame develops from red negative into full colour; selecting a look recuts the frame, garment docket and fit receipt together

systems.hero: A full-bleed generated campaign photograph is split by sliding film shutters and an offset contact strip; restrained logotype and production marks stay at the edges rather than covering the model with giant type
systems.navigation: A slim vertical film docket on desktop becomes a thumb-level numbered scene rail on mobile
systems.contentDensity: Long photographic breaths alternate with compact production metadata, a tactile styling workstation and a terse fit receipt
systems.geometry: 35 mm sprockets, crop marks, irregular darkroom masks, overlapping proof prints and narrow docket columns without rounded card grids
systems.motion: Scroll advances exposure and shutter masks; direct controls change frames immediately; small afterimages communicate a cut without delaying product access
systems.coreInteraction: Choose one of three complete looks, inspect its garment stack and fit note, select a size, and issue a numbered hold tag with the resolved look image and total

structuralDifferences: The hero starts as a portrait frame with the scene rail directly beneath the model instead of reproducing desktop shutters
The contact run becomes vertically snapped proof frames with visible previous and next buttons instead of a wide horizontal film bed
Style metadata is ordered before atmospheric material imagery so size and fit decisions remain one-hand reachable
The final hold result replaces the form inline as a perforated claim tag rather than opening a drawer or modal

artDirection.typography: A high-contrast editorial serif for the RIFT wordmark, a neutral grotesk for garment names and condensed mono for frame, exposure, fit and production notation; no oversized all-caps slogan formula
artDirection.material: Ink-black film, bone contact paper, electric cobalt light, dark cherry red safety marks, silver nylon, flash bloom and real fabric grain
artDirection.imageLogic: Four coordinated original AI-generated fashion photographs carry campaign narrative; one macro proves material; CSS film masks, sprockets and afterimages provide motion rather than fake 3D
artDirection.microcopy: Frame, exposure, take, shell, base, lower, cut, rise, drape, edition, hold and claim-tag language
artDirection.dataHonesty: Brand, collection, garments, inventory, pricing, frame numbers and confirmations are explicitly fictional demonstration content

assetStrategy: A five-frame original campaign is generated as one coordinated darkroom story. Each asset has a unique narrative role, crop and lighting condition; no image is reused as a generic card filler.

adjacentTemplates.why: NOMA is a calm coastal portrait lookbook with a quick-shop drawer; RIFT is a darkroom contact sheet whose frame selection synchronizes campaign, garment and inline hold state.
Maison Fold starts from code-native pattern assembly and private fitting; RIFT begins with finished ready-to-wear photography and a contact-sheet styling and size hold flow.
VECTOR is a technical three-column 3D chassis lab; RIFT uses full-bleed photographic proof, irregular film geometry and a human styling decision.
PULSE moves one can through liquid worlds and a bag; RIFT develops multiple human campaign frames and concludes with an inline sized-look claim tag.
SEREIN centres one product in an oval portal with soft cards; RIFT uses raw rectangular contact prints, garment dockets and shutter cuts.

avoid: Giant uppercase slogan covering the model
